claims.exact_statement: exact sufficiency iff behavior factors through the representation
claims.plain_language_statement: A representation preserves every declared exact behavior exactly when an image-level decoder exists.
claims.scope: any Set-based exact contract; decoder on reachable representation image
known_counterexamples_to_stronger_varian: decoder must be required only on the reachable representation image
limitations: exact and extensional
does not select the contract

claims.exact_statement: the observational quotient is the unique least-informative exact representation up to isomorphism
claims.plain_language_statement: Cases with identical declared behavior form the coarsest sufficient exact representation.
claims.scope: any Set-based exact contract; reachable-image isomorphism; cardinal minimum only when finite
known_counterexamples_to_stronger_varian: information minimality does not imply shortest code, fastest implementation, computability, or best explanation
limitations: set-level existence need not be computable
finite cardinal claim is a corollary of the image-to-quotient surjection

claims.exact_statement: context closure makes observational equivalence action-compatible
claims.plain_language_statement: When every allowed continuation is among the tests, actions descend to the observational quotient.
known_counterexamples_to_stronger_varian: without typed continuation closure an action need not preserve observational equivalence
limitations: only declared actions and tests
multi-argument operations require corresponding one-hole contexts

claims.exact_statement: no single representation is simultaneously a least-informative sufficient representation for every observation contract; universal sufficiency alone is not denied
claims.plain_language_statement: On a nontrivial domain, the constant and injective contracts demand incompatible minimal quotients, although identity remains sufficient for every contract.
claims.scope: nontrivial domain; observation contract varies; universal sufficiency not denied
known_counterexamples_to_stronger_varian: identity representation refutes the false stronger claim that universal sufficiency is impossible
limitations: requires two distinct domain elements
minimality is information-relative, not cost-relative

claims.exact_statement: invariants are antitone in the admitted re-representation class
claims.plain_language_statement: A property invariant under more admitted transformations is invariant under every smaller admitted class.
known_counterexamples_to_stronger_varian: incompatible source/target transformation classes make bare class inclusion ill-typed
limitations: representation-independent is incomplete until the transformation class is fixed

claims.exact_statement: unconstrained encoding establishes host capacity, not native common structure
claims.plain_language_statement: An injection can transport all named operations and relations to its image, so hosting alone cannot identify native shared structure.
claims.scope: injective transport with image decoder and no structure-preservation laws
known_counterexamples_to_stronger_varian: byte-perfect archive plus target-specific interpreter carries capacity while the decoder contains the source structure
limitations: does not formalize explanatory or native-structure predicates beyond non-uniqueness of transported structure

claims.exact_statement: primitive vocabulary count is not representation invariant
claims.plain_language_statement: Faithful reification and tagging can change the number and kinds of presentation primitives while preserving recoverable information.
known_counterexamples_to_stronger_varian: tuple reification converts a relation into occurrence objects and typed position edges
limitations: schema roles may remain useful
no global primitive independence follows

claims.exact_statement: finite operator count is not representation invariant
claims.plain_language_statement: A finite family can be combined into one tagged dispatcher and recovered by fixing each tag.
claims.scope: finite operator family with tagged tuples admitted
known_counterexamples_to_stronger_varian: one tagged dispatcher and the split family are mutually recoverable
limitations: a stricter operator language or cost contract can make count meaningful locally

claims.exact_statement: finite panels do not establish open-domain universality
claims.plain_language_statement: An off-panel case can make the universal claim true or false while every finite observation stays fixed.
claims.scope: proper finite panel of open domain without independent coverage premise
known_counterexamples_to_stronger_varian: extend the panel by one untested counterexample
limitations: an independent deductive coverage premise could bridge the complement

claims.exact_statement: exact common theory is relative to L,J,I; the substantive residue is additionally relative to Γ
claims.plain_language_statement: Holding interpreted models fixed, changing the frame cannot change their exact shared theory but can change what remains after frame consequences are removed.
claims.scope: fixed L,J,I and interpreted models; Gamma additionally indexes the residue
known_counterexamples_to_stronger_varian: fixed models with Gamma0 empty and Gamma1 containing a common nonvalid sentence leave exact theory fixed but change residue
limitations: truth-isomorphism invariance is relative to fixed logical semantics
Gamma affects exact theory only through a changed profile/model

claims.exact_statement: omitting a consequence-affecting parameter refutes sufficiency
claims.plain_language_statement: If two contexts share the stored x but a declared test gives different outcomes, a representation that stores only x collides.
limitations: requires an attainable pair and a declared behavior difference

claims.exact_statement: sufficient representations must preserve that distinction
claims.plain_language_statement: A sufficient representation cannot identify a case known absent with a case whose status is unknown when those are distinct outcomes.
claims.scope: contract distinguishes reachable determinate absence and Unknown
known_counterexamples_to_stronger_varian: historical UPP XA-005 collapses empty certified witness into Unknown
limitations: does not force one global fourth value
only contracts observing the distinction

claims.exact_statement: Ω is a semantically eliminable derived materialized view
claims.plain_language_statement: Canonical Omega records a calculus classification; composing representation and resolution yields the same consequence without an independent semantic intermediate.
claims.scope: canonical FARA Omega definition and semantic consequence composition
known_counterexamples_to_stronger_varian: Omega-only divergence with fixed causal input indicates hidden parameter, changed calculus, corruption, or extra information
limitations: operational caching, audit, interface, and provenance usefulness remains
not a causal irreducibility theorem

claims.exact_statement: Search-State Sufficiency is a bounded factorization instance, not a universal architecture
claims.plain_language_statement: Projected successor sets lose premise grouping for the stated MLL decoder class, while hyperedges and frontier states retain enough information under their exact rules.
claims.scope: only PR #453 SSS-1/2/3 stated state, transition-representation, and decoder classes; not a universal architecture
known_counterexamples_to_stronger_varian: arbitrary binary relation can encode provability
frontier state with binary transitions is sufficient
limitations: not a characterization
not an impossibility for binary relations generally
not novel
MLL and named LK profile only for SSS-3 witnesses
